text: Wo Long 2 just dropped a free alpha demo on Steam.
It's ninety gigabytes installed. Nearly fifty just to download.
It's Team NINJA's Three Kingdoms action RPG, where you fight demons with Chinese martial arts.
Combat looks fast and aggressive. Dodge, parry, and punish, against bosses that fill the screen.
Best moment in the trailer: you sprout wings of fire and slam a giant boss.
The catch? In the busiest fights, the sparks and effects make enemy attacks hard to read.
It's in eleven languages, and the full game lands March fourth, twenty twenty-seven.
Think Nioh, with a dash of Sekiro.
Worth a dip, if you've got ninety gigs free.
